meta.platformZh: iOS 與 Android 手機應用程式（Expo）
meta.audienceZh: 活動主辦人與現場閘口工作人員
meta.captureZh: 畫面以手機尺寸的瀏覽器視窗擷取（390 × 844，2 倍解析度）。相機與 NFC 屬於手機硬體，瀏覽器沒有，因此這兩個功能的相關畫面會顯示 App 自己的提示文字。
meta.captureEn: Screens were captured in a phone-sized browser window (390 x 844 at 2x). Camera and NFC are phone hardware, so the app's own notices appear on those screens instead of a live view.

organizer.descZh: 活動的擁有者，可看名單、設定與所有現場工具。
organizer.descEn: Owns the event. Can read the roster, settings and every door tool.

staff.descZh: 只被授權在現場報到與操作 NFC，讀不到完整名單。
staff.descEn: Trusted to check people in and work the NFC desk, but cannot read the full roster.

journeys.whenZh: 第一次拿到手機，或換了裝置之後。
journeys.whenEn: The first time you open the app, or after switching devices.
journeys.goalZh: 用自己的帳號登入，看到自己負責的活動。
journeys.goalEn: Get into your own account and see the events you run.
journeys.beforeZh: 已收到主辦方提供的帳號電郵與密碼。
journeys.beforeEn: You have the email and password your event owner gave you.
journeys.afterZh: 停在「我的活動」畫面，可以開始選活動。
journeys.afterEn: You land on My events and can pick an event.

steps.doZh: 打開 App。
steps.doEn: Open the app.
steps.seeZh: 出現登入畫面：上方是 App 名稱，中間要你填電郵與密碼。
steps.seeEn: The sign-in screen appears, asking for your email and password.

steps.doZh: 點一下電郵欄位，輸入你的電郵地址。
steps.doEn: Tap the email field and type your email address.
steps.seeZh: 欄位出現你輸入的文字。
steps.seeEn: The text you type shows in the field.

steps.doZh: 點密碼欄位輸入密碼，然後按「登入」。
steps.doEn: Tap the password field, type your password, then press Sign in.
steps.seeZh: 密碼會顯示成圓點。右邊的眼睛圖示可以切換顯示，確認自己有沒有打錯。
steps.seeEn: The password shows as dots. The eye icon on the right reveals it, in case you mistyped.

steps.doZh: 按「登入」。
steps.doEn: Press Sign in.
steps.seeZh: 登入成功後直接進入「我的活動」，畫面上列出你負責的活動。
steps.seeEn: You go straight to My events, listing the events you are responsible for.

annotate.whatZh: 已經登入，這是你的活動列表
annotate.whatEn: You are signed in; this is your event list

journeys.titleEn: Pick the event you are working on
journeys.whenZh: 每次打開 App 之後。
journeys.whenEn: Every time you open the app.
journeys.goalZh: 進入正確活動的現場工具。
journeys.goalEn: Get into the tools for the right event.
journeys.afterZh: 停在該活動的「活動概覽」。
journeys.afterEn: You are on that event's Overview.

steps.doZh: 在「我的活動」找你要辦的活動。
steps.doEn: Find the event you are working on in My events.
steps.seeZh: 每張活動卡顯示活動名稱、狀態、你的身分、報名人數與參展商數目。
steps.seeEn: Each card shows the event name, status, your role, and the number of registrations and exhibitors.

steps.doZh: 看一下卡片上的數字，確認是同一場活動。
steps.doEn: Check the numbers on the card to be sure it is the right event.
steps.seeZh: 報名人數與參展商數目就在名稱下方，不用點進去。
steps.seeEn: The registration and exhibitor counts sit under the name, no need to open it.

annotate.whatZh: 報名人數與參展商數目

steps.doZh: 點一下活動卡。
steps.doEn: Tap the event card.
steps.seeZh: 進入「活動概覽」，最上方是這場活動的即時數字。
steps.seeEn: You arrive at Overview, with this event's live numbers at the top.

journeys.titleEn: Check the phone status and sign out
journeys.whenZh: 開場前確認裝置沒問題，或交還手機給別人之前。
journeys.whenEn: Before doors open to confirm the device is fine, or before handing the phone to someone else.
journeys.goalZh: 確認 App 版本與 NFC 是否可用，需要時安全登出。
journeys.goalEn: Confirm the app version and whether NFC works, and sign out safely when needed.
journeys.afterZh: 知道這支手機能不能寫卡；登出後回到登入畫面。
journeys.afterEn: You know whether this phone can write badges; after signing out you are back at the sign-in screen.

steps.doZh: 點畫面最下方的「設定」。
steps.doEn: Tap Settings in the bottom bar.
steps.seeZh: 看到「帳號」與「裝置」兩段資料。
steps.seeEn: You see two sections: Account and Device.

annotate.whatZh: 帳號：你是用哪個身分登入
annotate.whatEn: Account: who you are signed in as

steps.doZh: 看「NFC 狀態」那一行。
steps.doEn: Look at the NFC status row.
steps.seeZh: 顯示「支援」代表這支手機可以寫卡與讀卡；顯示「不支援」就要換另一支手機做 NFC 工作。
steps.seeEn: Supported means this phone can write and read badges. Not supported means you need another phone for NFC work.

annotate.whatZh: NFC 狀態決定這支手機能不能寫卡
annotate.whatEn: NFC status decides whether this phone can write badges

annotate.whatZh: 回報問題時要說出這個版本號
annotate.whatEn: Quote this version when reporting a problem

steps.doZh: 要交還手機時，捲到最下面按「登出」。
steps.doEn: When handing the phone over, scroll down and press Sign out.
steps.seeZh: 回到登入畫面，別人就看不到你的活動資料。
steps.seeEn: You return to the sign-in screen, so the next person cannot see your event data.

annotate.whatEn: Press this before handing the phone over

journeys.whenZh: 開場前，以及現場期間每隔一段時間。
journeys.whenEn: Before doors open, and every so often during the day.
journeys.goalZh: 一眼看出報名人數、已報到人數與到場率。
journeys.goalEn: Read registrations, check-ins and attendance rate at a glance.
journeys.afterZh: 知道現場節奏，並可直接跳到常用工具。
journeys.afterEn: You know how the door is going and can jump straight to a tool.

steps.doZh: 打開這場活動的「活動概覽」。
steps.doEn: Open this event's Overview.
steps.seeZh: 四格數字：報名人數、已報到、參展商、到場率。
steps.seeEn: Four figures: registrations, checked in, exhibitors, attendance rate.

steps.doZh: 如果某格顯示「—」而不是數字，看它下面那行說明。
steps.doEn: If a figure shows a dash instead of a number, read the note under it.
steps.seeZh: 破折號代表「這個數字沒拿到」，不是「零」。畫面上會寫明原因。
steps.seeEn: A dash means the figure could not be read, not that it is zero. The note explains why.

steps.doZh: 往下看「快速操作」，這裡是現場最常用的入口。
steps.doEn: Scroll to Quick actions, the shortcuts you will use most on the door.
steps.seeZh: 七個按鈕：掃碼簽到、Token、名單、NFC 寫卡、讀取 tagUid、交換名片、Badge。
steps.seeEn: Seven buttons: scan check-in, Token, roster, write NFC badge, read tagUid, exchange contacts, badges.

annotate.whatEn: Scan check-in: the one you use most
Write NFC badge: to issue a wristband

journeys.whenZh: 開場之前，和發到手環用完的時候。
journeys.whenEn: Before doors open, and whenever you run out of wristbands.
journeys.goalZh: 知道還有幾張空白卡、已經發出去幾張。
journeys.goalEn: Know how many blank badges are left and how many are already issued.
journeys.afterZh: 心裡有數，知道要不要再拆一批新卡。
journeys.afterEn: You know whether you need to open a fresh batch.

steps.doZh: 從「快速操作」按「Badge」。
steps.doEn: Press Badges in Quick actions.
steps.seeZh: 上方是查詢框，下方是這場活動所有的 Badge。
steps.seeEn: A lookup box on top, and every badge for this event below.

annotate.whatZh: 知道卡片編號時用這裡查
annotate.whatEn: Use this when you know the card number

steps.doZh: 看每張卡的狀態標籤。
steps.doEn: Read the status label on each card.
steps.seeZh: 「未綁定」是還沒發出去的空白卡；「啟用」是已經發給人、正在使用。
steps.seeEn: Unassigned means a blank badge not yet issued. Active means it is on someone and in use.

steps.doZh: 看每張卡的批次名稱。
steps.doEn: Read the batch name on each card.
steps.seeZh: 批次名稱告訴你這張卡是從哪一疊拿出來的，方便對帳。
steps.seeEn: The batch name tells you which stack the badge came from, which makes reconciling easier.

journeys.whenZh: 開場之前，先了解會來哪些人。
journeys.whenEn: Before doors open, to see who is coming.
journeys.goalZh: 看得懂名單上每一列在講什麼。
journeys.goalEn: Understand what each row on the roster is telling you.
journeys.beforeZh: 已經進入這場活動，而且你的帳號讀得到名單。
journeys.beforeEn: You are inside the event, and your account is allowed to read the roster.
journeys.afterZh: 知道怎麼看一列報名，也知道怎麼複製報名編號。
journeys.afterEn: You know how to read a registration row and how to copy a registration code.

steps.doZh: 從「快速操作」按「名單」。
steps.doEn: Press Roster in Quick actions.
steps.seeZh: 看到這場活動的報名清單。
steps.seeEn: You see this event's list of registrations.

steps.doZh: 讀一列報名。
steps.doEn: Read one registration row.
steps.seeZh: 由左至右是姓名、電郵（中間會打星號保護）、狀態標籤、報名編號、公司、報名時間。
steps.seeEn: Left to right: name, email (partly starred for privacy), status label, registration code, company, and when they registered.

annotate.whatZh: 這一列就是一位報名者

annotate.whatEn: Status: confirmed means they may enter

steps.doZh: 點一下報名編號。
steps.doEn: Tap the registration code.
steps.seeZh: 編號會被複製起來，方便你貼到別的系統或傳給同事。
steps.seeEn: The code is copied so you can paste it elsewhere or send it to a colleague.

journeys.whenZh: 參加者遞上手機或紙本上的 QR code 時。這是最快的方法。
journeys.whenEn: When an attendee holds up a QR code on their phone or on paper. This is the fastest way.
journeys.goalZh: 把 QR code 換成一次報到紀錄。
journeys.goalEn: Turn a QR code into a check-in record.
journeys.beforeZh: 已在活動的掃碼簽到畫面，並且相機可用。
journeys.beforeEn: You are on the scan screen for this event and the camera works.
journeys.afterZh: 畫面顯示報到結果，約 15 秒後自動回到掃碼狀態，應付下一個人。
journeys.afterEn: The result appears, then the screen returns to scanning after about 15 seconds, ready for the next person.

steps.doZh: 從「快速操作」按「掃碼簽到」。
steps.doEn: Press Scan check-in in Quick actions.
steps.seeZh: 看到上方「總簽到」，下方是掃描框。
steps.seeEn: The running check-in total sits on top, with the scanning frame below.

annotate.whatZh: 把 QR code 對準這個框
annotate.whatEn: Aim the QR code at this frame

steps.doZh: 把手機對準參加者的 QR code，保持約 15 公分。
steps.doEn: Point the phone at the attendee's QR code, about 15 cm away.
steps.seeZh: 畫面顯示「確認中…」，不用按任何按鈕，它會自己讀。
steps.seeEn: The screen shows Checking, you do not press anything, it reads by itself.

steps.doZh: 讀到之後，看結果卡。
steps.doEn: When it reads, look at the result card.
steps.seeZh: 綠色的「報到成功」代表可以放行，卡片上會顯示姓名、票種與報到時間。
steps.seeEn: A green Checked in means you can let them through. The card shows their name, ticket type and check-in time.

annotate.whatZh: 核對姓名與本人是否相同
annotate.whatEn: Check the name matches the person

steps.doZh: 如果這位參加者要拿手環，直接按「寫入 NFC 卡」，不用重新輸入編號。
steps.doEn: If this attendee needs a wristband, press Write NFC badge. You do not have to retype the code.
steps.seeZh: 自動帶著剛才那位參加者的資料跳到寫卡畫面，每人可省下 30 到 60 秒。
steps.seeEn: It carries the attendee's details over to the badge screen, saving 30 to 60 seconds per person.

annotate.whatEn: Press to continue to badge writing

journeys.titleZh: 相機不能用時，改用手動輸入
journeys.titleEn: When the camera will not work, type the code
journeys.whenZh: QR code 破了、手機反光、或相機被其他程式佔用時。
journeys.whenEn: When the QR code is damaged, the screen reflects, or another app is holding the camera.
journeys.goalZh: 一樣完成報到，不用叫參加者重排。
journeys.goalEn: Still check the person in, without sending them back to the queue.
journeys.beforeZh: 已在活動的掃碼簽到畫面。
journeys.beforeEn: You are on the scan screen for this event.
journeys.afterZh: 跟掃碼一樣得到報到結果。
journeys.afterEn: You get the same result as scanning.

steps.doZh: 如果畫面顯示「無法取得相機權限」，先按「允許使用相機」再試一次。
steps.doEn: If the screen says the camera is unavailable, press Allow camera and try again.
steps.seeZh: 多數情況按一次就會好。
steps.seeEn: Usually one press is enough.

steps.doZh: 還是不行，就按「改用輸入模式」。
steps.doEn: If it still will not work, press Switch to typing.
steps.seeZh: 掃描框變成一個輸入框。
steps.seeEn: The scanning frame becomes a text box.

steps.doZh: 把參加者提供的報名編號打進去，例如 LKC-202611-A1B2C3。
steps.doEn: Type the registration code the attendee gives you, for example LKC-202611-A1B2C3.
steps.seeZh: 大小寫不拘，前後多打了空格也沒關係，系統會自己校正。
steps.seeEn: Case does not matter, and stray spaces are fine, the system corrects them.

steps.doZh: 按「查詢並報到」。
steps.doEn: Press Look up and check in.
steps.seeZh: 出現跟掃碼一樣的結果卡。
steps.seeEn: The same result card appears as with scanning.

journeys.goalZh: 知道哪一種可以放行、哪一種要叫主管。
journeys.goalEn: Know which outcome lets someone through and which needs a supervisor.
journeys.beforeZh: 已經完成至少一次查詢。
journeys.beforeEn: You have completed at least one lookup.
journeys.afterZh: 遇到任何結果都知道下一步做什麼。
journeys.afterEn: You know what to do next for every outcome.

steps.doZh: 這是第一種：報到成功。
steps.doEn: Outcome one: checked in.
steps.seeZh: 綠色標題「報到成功」，代表這張票有效而且剛剛完成報到。直接放行。
steps.seeEn: A green Checked in headline means the ticket was valid and is now checked in. Let them through.

steps.doZh: 這是第二種：重複簽到。
steps.doEn: Outcome two: already checked in.
steps.seeZh: 標題是「重複簽到」，代表這個人剛剛已經報到過。不要重複放行，先問他是不是已經進場了。
steps.seeEn: The headline says Already checked in, meaning this person was checked in earlier. Do not wave them through again, ask whether they already entered.

annotate.whatEn: Not a new arrival, confirm first

steps.doZh: 這是第三種：無效報名。
steps.doEn: Outcome three: invalid registration.
steps.seeZh: 標題是「無效報名」，代表查不到這張票。先確認編號有沒有打錯，再請參加者出示原本的確認信。
steps.seeEn: The headline says Invalid registration, meaning this ticket was not found. Check for a typo first, then ask for their original confirmation email.

steps.doZh: 如果是連線問題，畫面會顯示「網路連線異常」。
steps.doEn: If the network is the problem, the screen says the connection failed.
steps.seeZh: 這句話跟「無效報名」完全不同：票可能是好的。改用人工核對或換個網路再試，不要當成假票。
steps.seeEn: That is not the same as an invalid ticket. The ticket may be fine. Verify by hand or switch networks, but do not treat it as fake.

annotate.whatZh: 是網路問題，不是票的問題
annotate.whatEn: A network problem, not a ticket problem

journeys.whenZh: 有人臨時到場，沒有事先報名。
journeys.whenEn: Someone turns up without having registered.
journeys.goalZh: 替他建立一筆報名，然後照常報到。
journeys.goalEn: Create a registration for them, then check them in as usual.
journeys.beforeZh: 已知道要給他哪一種票。
journeys.beforeEn: You know which ticket type to give them.
journeys.afterZh: 名單多一筆紀錄，可以直接接去簽到或寫卡。
journeys.afterEn: The roster gains a record, and you can carry straight on to check-in or badge writing.

steps.doZh: 從概覽的「快速操作」按「名單」，或直接打開現場補報名。
steps.doEn: Open walk-in registration from the door tools.
steps.seeZh: 看到一張表單：票種、電子郵件、名、姓、電話、公司。
steps.seeEn: A form appears: ticket type, email, first name, last name, phone, company.

steps.doZh: 填寫參加者的資料，把星號欄位填滿。
steps.doEn: Fill in the attendee's details, completing the starred fields.
steps.seeZh: 名與姓分開兩格，電話與公司可留空。
steps.seeEn: First and last name are separate fields; phone and company are optional.

annotate.target: text=我已閱讀並同意服務條款與隱私政策
annotate.whatEn: You must tick the consent box

steps.doZh: 跟參加者讀一次條款，然後勾選同意，按「建立報名」。
steps.doEn: Read the terms to the attendee, tick consent, then press Create registration.
steps.seeZh: 顯示「已建立報名」。
steps.seeEn: The screen confirms the registration was created.

steps.doZh: 接著按「前往簽到」或「前往寫卡」。
steps.doEn: Then press Go to check-in or Go to badge.
steps.seeZh: 提醒：需要付款的票種，報名建立了但還未付款，不能當成已入場。
steps.seeEn: Note: for paid tickets the registration exists but is unpaid, so it does not count as entry.

journeys.whenZh: 有人來問自己的報名、或你要確認某個人到了沒有。
journeys.whenEn: Someone asks about their registration, or you need to confirm whether a person has arrived.
journeys.beforeEn: You are on the roster screen.
journeys.afterZh: 找到人，可以接去看詳情。
journeys.afterEn: You found them and can open their detail.

steps.doZh: 要只看某一種狀態，就按上面的篩選標籤。
steps.doEn: To see one status only, press a filter chip at the top.
steps.seeZh: 可以選全部、已確認、已報到、待付款、已取消。
steps.seeEn: You can choose all, confirmed, checked in, awaiting payment, or cancelled.

annotate.whatEn: Show only people who have checked in

steps.doZh: 要換排序，按「報名時間」或「姓名」。
steps.doEn: To re-sort, press Registered or Name.
steps.seeZh: 清單立即重新排列。
steps.seeEn: The list re-sorts straight away.

steps.doZh: 找不到就清除篩選，再往下捲。
steps.doEn: If you cannot find them, clear the filters and scroll down.
steps.seeZh: 如果完全沒有符合的報名，畫面會說「沒有符合的報名」並提示清除篩選。
steps.seeEn: If nothing matches, the screen says there are no matching registrations and suggests clearing the filters.

journeys.whenZh: 要確認簽到時間、Token 餘額或票種的時候。
journeys.whenEn: When you need to confirm a check-in time, a token balance, or a ticket type.
journeys.goalZh: 把一個人的所有紀錄看在一頁上。
journeys.goalEn: See everything about one person on a single page.
journeys.beforeEn: You are on the roster screen.
journeys.afterEn: Press Back to return to the roster.

steps.doZh: 點一下那個人的姓名那一列。
steps.doEn: Tap the row with that person's name.
steps.seeZh: 進入「查看詳情」。注意：點報名編號只會複製編號，不會進入詳情。
steps.seeEn: You enter the detail view. Note: tapping the registration code only copies it, it does not open the detail.

annotate.whatEn: Tap the name row to open the detail

steps.doZh: 看「基本資料」與「報名」兩段。
steps.doEn: Read the Profile and Registration sections.
steps.seeZh: 姓名、電郵、電話、公司、票種、報名時間都在這裡。
steps.seeEn: Name, email, phone, company, ticket type and registration time are all here.

steps.doZh: 往下看「簽到」、「Token 流水」、「綁定 NFC」三段。
steps.doEn: Scroll to the Check-in, Token history and NFC sections.
steps.seeZh: 如果某一段顯示「—」或「查不到綁定卡」，那代表後端還沒有這筆資料，不是系統壞了。
steps.seeEn: If a section shows a dash or says no bound badge was found, the backend simply has no record yet. It does not mean something is broken.

journeys.titleEn: Why door staff cannot open the roster
journeys.whenZh: 用閘口帳號登入之後，發現名單打不開。
journeys.whenEn: You signed in with the door account and the roster will not open.
journeys.goalZh: 知道這是權限設計，不是手機壞了。
journeys.goalEn: Understand this is a permission boundary, not a broken phone.
journeys.beforeZh: 以閘口工作人員帳號登入。
journeys.beforeEn: Signed in with the door-staff account.
journeys.afterZh: 知道要看名單要換主辦或協調員帳號。
journeys.afterEn: You know to switch to an owner or coordinator account to read the roster.

steps.doZh: 以閘口工作人員的帳號登入。
steps.doEn: Sign in with the door-staff account.
steps.seeZh: 活動卡上顯示的身分是 OPERATOR，不是 OWNER。
steps.seeEn: The event card shows your role as OPERATOR rather than OWNER.

annotate.whatZh: 你的身分是閘口工作人員
annotate.whatEn: You are signed in as door staff

steps.doZh: 照樣打開名單。
steps.doEn: Open the roster anyway.
steps.seeZh: 畫面顯示「閘口帳號暫時讀不了名單」，並說明後端目前仍要求主辦或協調員權限。報到與寫卡不受影響。
steps.seeEn: The screen explains that the roster needs an owner or coordinator account on the backend. Check-in and badge writing are unaffected.

annotate.whatZh: 這是權限限制，不是故障
annotate.whatEn: A permission limit, not a fault

journeys.titleEn: Write a wristband for an attendee
journeys.whenZh: 參加者完成報到，要拿手環進場的時候。
journeys.whenEn: An attendee has checked in and needs a wristband to enter.
journeys.goalZh: 把一張空白手環綁定到某一位參加者身上。
journeys.goalEn: Bind one blank wristband to one attendee.
journeys.beforeZh: 手邊有空白手環，而且手機支援 NFC。
journeys.beforeEn: You have blank wristbands and the phone supports NFC.
journeys.afterZh: 手環綁定完成，可以交給參加者。
journeys.afterEn: The wristband is bound and ready to hand over.

steps.doZh: 從「快速操作」按「NFC 寫卡」。
steps.doEn: Press Write NFC badge in Quick actions.
steps.seeZh: 看到第一步「輸入報名編號以查詢參加者」。
steps.seeEn: Step one appears: enter a registration code to look up the attendee.
steps.captureNoteZh: 這張截圖在瀏覽器上擷取，瀏覽器沒有 NFC，所以畫面出現 App 自己的提示。手機上不會有這行提示，其餘畫面相同。
steps.captureNoteEn: Captured in a browser, which has no NFC, so the app's own notice appears. On a phone that notice is absent; everything else is the same.

annotate.target: text=① 輸入報名編號以查詢參加者

annotate.whatZh: 換卡／補發／退卡目前還不能用
annotate.whatEn: Replace, reissue and return are not available yet

steps.doZh: 輸入參加者的報名編號，或用報到結果卡跳過來。
steps.doEn: Enter the attendee's registration code, or arrive here from the check-in result card.
steps.seeZh: 找到人之後，畫面會顯示姓名與票種讓你確認。
steps.seeEn: Once found, the screen shows their name and ticket type so you can confirm.

steps.doZh: 按「查詢並報到」，確認螢幕上的人是對的。
steps.doEn: Press Look up and check in, and confirm the person on screen is right.
steps.seeZh: 第二步出現：「選擇 Badge 類型，然後將空白 NFC 卡靠近手機背面」。
steps.seeEn: Step two appears: choose a badge type, then hold a blank NFC card to the back of the phone.

annotate.target: text=② 選擇 Badge 類型
annotate.whatEn: Step two: choose a type, then tap the card

steps.doZh: 選「手環」，然後按「開始寫入 NFC 卡」。
steps.doEn: Choose Wristband, then press Start writing the NFC badge.
steps.seeZh: 畫面顯示「寫入中，請保持卡片靠近…」，這時不要移動手環。
steps.seeEn: The screen says writing, keep the card close. Do not move the wristband now.

steps.doZh: 看到「NFC 綁定成功」才把手環交給參加者。
steps.doEn: Hand the wristband over only once the screen confirms the binding succeeded.
steps.seeZh: 如果顯示「寫卡失敗」或「寫卡逾時」，這張卡不算完成，請重新感應再試一次。畫面上會直接寫明「勿當成成功」。
steps.seeEn: If it reports a failure or a timeout, the badge is not done. Tap again and retry; the screen says explicitly not to treat it as success.

annotate.whatEn: Only done when you see this

journeys.titleZh: 讀卡片編號與交換名片
journeys.titleEn: Read a card number and exchange contacts
journeys.whenZh: 要查一張手環是誰的，或讓兩位參加者互相留下聯絡方式。
journeys.whenEn: You need to identify whose wristband this is, or two attendees want to swap details.
journeys.goalZh: 讀出卡片編號，或用兩次感應記錄一組交換。
journeys.goalEn: Read a card number, or record one exchange with two taps.
journeys.afterZh: 拿到卡片編號，或完成一筆交換紀錄。
journeys.afterEn: You have the card number, or one exchange is recorded.

steps.doZh: 從「快速操作」按「讀取 tagUid」。
steps.doEn: Press Read tagUid in Quick actions.
steps.seeZh: 畫面提示「將 NFC 卡靠近手機背面，讀取卡片硬體編號」。
steps.seeEn: The screen asks you to hold the NFC card to the back of the phone to read its hardware number.
steps.captureNoteZh: 同樣在瀏覽器擷取，因此出現不支援 NFC 的提示。
steps.captureNoteEn: Also captured in a browser, so the no-NFC notice appears.

steps.doZh: 讀到之後可以按「複製 tagUid」。
steps.doEn: Once read, press Copy tagUid.
steps.seeZh: 卡片編號已複製，可以貼給同事或拿去 Badge 頁查詢。
steps.seeEn: The card number is copied, ready to paste to a colleague or look up on the badge page.

steps.doZh: 要讓兩人交換名片，按「交換名片」。
steps.doEn: To let two people swap details, open Exchange contacts.
steps.seeZh: 畫面說明流程：「先感應第一張卡，畫面上出現姓名後，再感應對方的卡。」
steps.seeEn: The screen states the order: tap the first card, wait for the name to appear, then tap the other person's card.
steps.captureNoteZh: 交換名片需要感應兩張實體卡，瀏覽器無法示範，只能顯示 App 的說明畫面。
steps.captureNoteEn: Exchanging contacts needs two physical taps, which a browser cannot demonstrate, so only the app's instructions are shown.

steps.doZh: 照著畫面感應第二張卡，等「已交換」出現。
steps.doEn: Tap the second card as prompted, and wait for the confirmation.
steps.seeZh: 如果顯示「已交換過」，代表這兩張卡先前已經交換過，系統不會重複寫入，這是正常的。
steps.seeEn: If it says already exchanged, these two cards met before and nothing was written twice. That is normal.

journeys.titleEn: The token desk, and what to do when the network drops
journeys.whenZh: 參加者要加值 Token，或者現場網路不穩。
journeys.whenEn: An attendee wants tokens, or the venue network is patchy.
journeys.goalZh: 知道 Token 櫃台在網頁上，以及遇到連線問題時怎麼處理。
journeys.goalEn: Know that the token desk lives on the web, and how to handle a connection problem.
journeys.afterZh: 不會在 App 裡白找 Token 功能，也不會把連線問題當成假票。
journeys.afterEn: You will not hunt for token features in the app, and will not mistake a network problem for a fake ticket.

steps.doZh: 按「快速操作」裡的「Token」。
steps.doEn: Press Token in Quick actions.
steps.seeZh: App 告訴你 Token 櫃台以網頁為主，這裡只保留入口。
steps.seeEn: The app explains that the token desk is web-first and this is only a doorway.

annotate.whatEn: The app does not host the full desk

steps.doZh: 按「在網頁打開櫃台」。
steps.doEn: Press Open the desk on the web.
steps.seeZh: 會用手機的瀏覽器打開網頁版，用同一個帳號就能操作。
steps.seeEn: It opens the web console in your phone's browser, where the same account works.

annotate.whatZh: 加值與扣款都在網頁做
annotate.whatEn: Top-ups and deductions happen on the web

steps.doZh: 如果報到時看到「網路連線異常」或「伺服器暫時異常」。
steps.doEn: If check-in reports a network or server problem.
steps.seeZh: 這跟「找不到此報名」是兩件不同的事。票可能是好的，請改用人工核對或換個網路重試，不要當成假票處理。
steps.seeEn: This is not the same as a registration not being found. The ticket may be fine: verify by hand or switch networks, but do not treat it as fake.

annotate.whatZh: 連線不穩時改用手動輸入再試
annotate.whatEn: When the network is patchy, switch to typing and retry

steps.doZh: 遇到重複報到、要放行例外狀況時，按「申請主管覆核」。
steps.doEn: For a duplicate or an exception you want to allow, press Request supervisor override.
steps.seeZh: 這個功能還沒開放。畫面會直接說明後端尚未就緒，現場請人工放行並留下紀錄，不要自己改資料。
steps.seeEn: This feature is not open yet. The screen states the backend is not ready, so let the person through by hand and keep a written record rather than changing data yourself.

annotate.whatZh: 目前還不能用，請人工處理
annotate.whatEn: Not available yet, handle it by hand
